text:
harry-finance: Heads-up — Sentinel Bio (private deploy) flagged a midterm support-tier change effective 2026-10-05. We already invoiced platform fee across two invoices (INV-118800 and INV-118801). They want a single settlement that reconciles both invoices and avoids touching reseller commission. Need a path before renewal notification.

mina-billing: Which SOW and reseller? I need exact effective date to compute prorations and locate both invoice lines.

harry-finance: SOW SN-12-Z. Reseller is MeridianCloud (alex-partnerops). Effective 2026-10-05. Customer prefers one credit memo they can apply to either invoice.

billing-bot: Metering export ready: /exports/sentinel_222555_batch.csv

billing-bot: CSV preview:
```
date,resource,units,charge_usd
2026-09-01,platform_fee_invoice,INV-118800,45000
2026-09-15,platform_fee_invoice,INV-118801,15000
2026-10-01,onprem_vcpu_hours,6200,0
2026-10-05,change_event,1,0
```

julia-account: Quick numbers: Combined annual platform fees billed = $60,000 (INV-118800 $45k + INV-118801 $15k). Original annual EnterprisePlus = $60k; new tier StandardPlus = $42k. Annual delta = $18,000. Remaining from 2026-10-05 to 2027-01-01 ~ 2.87 months => factor 0.2392. Prorated credit = 18,000 * 0.2392 = $4,305. Customer asked for rounding to nearest $5 => $4,305 -> $4,305 (keep as is) but prefers $4,300 to avoid micro-amounts.

nate-cs: Customer wants the number rounded down to $4,300 and an explicit line "applies across invoices INV-118800 & INV-118801". They also asked for partner non-clawback language.

alex-partnerops: MeridianCloud will request commission protection. We can approve a "no-clawback" for a settlement under $10k if legal includes a partner waiver. Will need partnerops email confirmation.

linda-legal: Draft settlement clause: "This credit memo constitutes final settlement of the platform fee differential arising from the 2026-10-05 support tier change under SOW SN-12-Z and applies to invoices INV-118800 and INV-118801. MeridianCloud waives any commission clawback in respect of this settlement." Finance lead sign-off required.

sam-cfo: I approve issuing a single credit memo for $4,300 with the settlement and partner waiver language. Sam-cfo: signing off.

mina-billing: I'll create provisional credit CM-222555-01 for $4,300, status PendingPartnerAck, and tag AR to hold reversal on the two invoices. Posting internal note referencing SOW SN-12-Z and both invoice IDs.

alex-partnerops: Partner Ops ack: MeridianCloud confirms no clawback for CM-222555-01. Sending internal confirmation to billing.

mina-billing: Partner ack received. Updating CM-222555-01 to Final, posting to AR, and attaching legal text. Collections: do not reverse partner commissions.

julia-account: Posted accounting memo SN-12-Z_platform_adj_222555 and updated revenue schedule. Will attach credit memo PDF to both invoice records.

harry-finance: I'll send settlement PDF to Sentinel AP with subject "Final settlement of platform fee differential (applies to INV-118800 & INV-118801)". Nate, please confirm once they accept.

nate-cs: Sent to ap@sentinelbio.com. Customer replied: "Accepted, will apply to INV-118801 and close INV-118800 as billed."

mina-billing: CM-222555-01 issued, AR updated, partner waiver attached. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
